propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard invokes git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, projecting 207.4 runner-seconds and 75s wall-time savings on the full 13,255-test suite if eliminated.

Replacing two per-test Git subprocesses with in-process HEAD fingerprinting requires safe handling of symbolic loose refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, and linked worktrees without adding external Git library dependencies.

Four consensus OSS projects (pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) keep source-checkout Git subprocesses out of the per-test hot path, but none maintains rebar's stricter per-test checkout-HEAD attribution guard that names the responsible test.

No fidelity-preserving implementation option met the automatic-approval bar: adding a Git library expands dependency risk, hand-parsing all ref/storage formats is unsafe, and removing the per-test guard weakens test coverage and attribution.
